review.scope: Admission-reserve/purpose accounting/subset/contract delta and v13 pending-graph/counter harness only; no actual catalog/model run, metadata parity rerun or broad full suite.

resolved_findings.issue: Admission used min(reserve, actual remaining), discarding a rankable uncached product when max_fp3 left2 calls but reserve1.
resolved_findings.resolution: Subset selection uses actual global remainder; reserve only protects admission by limiting generation. Real audited-route regression verifies total3 and successful admission.

resolved_findings.issue: Phase1 half cap was applied to max_steps1 as well as two-step generation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Depth cap requires phase1 AND max_steps2. One-step regression computes uncached fingerprints beyond half toward G; separate two-step control retains phase1 cap.

resolved_findings.issue: Rank-unassessed and ranked-but-callback-unattempted were conflated in interpretation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Separate admission_callback_unattempted_products plus existing pending/ranked/attempted counters; deadline-after-first-callback regression verifies distinction.

reviewed_invariants: R=min(2*max_products,max_fp//2), G=max_fp-R. Initial hit is charged once. Two-step phase1 uses min(max_fp//2,G); single-step and phase2 use G. Admission uses global ceiling.

Cached-product-first then canonical-SMILES deterministic subset reserves zero-or-one new rank fingerprint plus one possible callback fingerprint for each selected product before similarity ordering. Products without a fingerprint are never given a synthetic similarity rank.

Generation exhaustion has separate labels and historical global exhaustion no longer causes wholesale pending-product discard. Eligible subset proceeds to unchanged exact forward replay/strict route audit subject to deadline and route cap.
Admission may spend unused generation allowance without exceeding total budget for callbacks obeying the existing zero-or-one counted fingerprint contract.

Callback counter delta is checked in finally, including rejection paths; decrease/more-than-one/total overflow raises RuntimeError after recording observed count. This detects but cannot prevent arbitrary custom callbacks from violating their contract; no silent clamping or masked charges.

Purpose sum hit+generation+admission ranking+callback is checked against reported total at completion. Rank-unassessed includes unranked products due to budget or deadline, not chemical failure; ranked-but-unattempted has a distinct counter.

v13 retains existing panel/config/gates/four-source before-after binding/result overwrite guard. Added pending graphs are explicitly unverified snapshots bounded by max_products, separate from eligible route details; all new purpose/admission counters are captured.

independent_checks.result: 66 passed in13.18s on final runtime/test hashes. Covers real audited pending-route admission after generation exhaustion, tiny cached/uncached budgets, spare generation reuse, single/two-step ceiling distinction, deadline callback interruption, contract violation and existing replay/telemetry controls.
Match frozen handoff; no source changes after verification.

limitations: No fixed-panel v13 or actual catalog/model run by reviewer; implementation pass is not efficacy evidence.

Deadline still stops work and can prevent pending or accepted products reaching audit; pending snapshots do not certify chemical eligibility.
